units.summary: New test. It injects an append through the pre-evict hook and checks that the late sample survives compaction and a restart when isolation is on. When isolation is off, it asserts the late sample is lost, which is the documented limitation.
units.headline: New test: late append before eviction survives restart
units.reason: New test only; cannot change production behavior.

units.summary: New test. An appender opened before compaction commits inside the pre-evict hook, and the test checks that the series is kept in the head and the sample survives a restart. It is skipped when isolation is disabled.
units.headline: New test: pre-opened appender committing mid-compaction keeps its series
units.reason: New test only; cannot change production behavior.

units.summary: New helper that returns s.ooo == nil. The selected-series filter and both eviction predicates use it. On its own it is trivial; its effect shows up in the units that call it.
units.headline: Add isSeriesWithoutOOO predicate helper
units.reason: One-line helper with obvious semantics; the risk sits in its callers.

units.summary: Moves the stale-NaN check out of gcStaleSeries into a helper. The logic is unchanged and covers float, histogram and float-histogram last values.
units.headline: Extract stale-NaN check into isStaleSeries helper
units.reason: Same logic as the removed inline check, just moved into a helper.

units.summary: Now takes an appendID watermark and goes through the generic truncateSeries with a predicate. A series is evicted only if it has no OOO data, is still stale, and has no append IDs above the watermark. The OOO check at eviction time is new.
units.headline: Stale eviction now also checks OOO data and the appendID watermark
units.reason: Changes which series get evicted and tombstoned in the WAL, so mistakes can lose data.
focus: Watermark is captured before the block write, so commits from appenders opened earlier are covered
truncateSeries' boundary change from >= to > on MinTime vs maxt

units.summary: New eviction function for CompactSelectedSeries. It evicts every listed series that has no OOO data and no append IDs above the watermark, whether or not the series is stale. Series with maxTime > maxt are still skipped inside gcSeries.
units.headline: New truncateSelectedSeries evicts listed series, guarded by OOO and watermark
units.reason: New public-path eviction of non-stale series that writes WAL tombstones; a wrong predicate loses data.
focus: With isolation disabled the guard does nothing, so a late in-range append is lost (the test confirms this); check that is acceptable for Mimir
Whether txs cleanup could drop a late append ID before eviction runs

units.summary: Walks the series' txRing of uncleaned append IDs and reports whether any is above the watermark. It returns false when txs is nil (isolation disabled). The comment's 'always returns false' claim matches the code, because the early return happens whenever txs is nil.
units.headline: New appendID watermark check over the series txRing
units.reason: Core race guard that decides whether a series with late writes gets evicted, which risks data loss.
focus: Callers hold s.Lock while gcSeries evaluates shouldEvict
A late append's ID cannot be removed by cleanupAppendIDsBelow before eviction, which would let the series be evicted
